suite.index_note: The public index averages the 37 benchmarks of the 0.2.1 panel in five areas, with GSM8K rebuilt and ForecastBench retired. Each benchmark is chance-corrected first, (score - chance) / (1 - chance) clipped to 0-1, so 0 means random guessing and 100 means perfect. Every score is coverage-adjusted, so an unanswered or unsupported request counts as wrong. The headline Full score comes from private tests only; this public index is shown alongside it, and benchmarks marked + also show each model's score on the private benchmark of the same competency.
changes: The main ranking is the Full score: 60% private tests of the same skills and 40% private tasks from new domains, each put on the public scale using untuned stock models. Public benchmarks are still run and shown, but no longer count toward the Full score, so the ranking rests entirely on tests nobody can train on.
GSM8K is rebuilt, ForecastBench is retired from the public index, and WinoGrande now counts under Knowledge & Reasoning.

rows.name: baselabs mammoth-1 (27B)
notes: New in the 2026-10-18 PR batch (PR #244); updated to revision 9d1962f in PR #260.

Public 0.3 run from PR #260 adopted (kit rescore 75.34, equal to the claim). Private tests run by the lab on one RTX PRO 6000 with the author's serving at revision 8f9f8619, whose weights are identical to 9d1962f; decision agreement with the submitted rows 99.85% on 831 rows (bar 98.5%).
Weights are public on the Hugging Face Hub under a proprietary license.
Training data not disclosed.

One private new-domain test is not counted for this model: our checks found signs its training data overlapped it. Its new-domain score uses the remaining tests, put on the same scale with the same stock models.
